method.native_rule: header 13; 12-byte ordinal|UID|UID identity; UID nonzero and strictly increasing; footer 9

sensitivity_notes.identity_13: 13-byte t50-style lookahead is not native; marker-0 controls retain the ordinal 69705 break, while selector-lookahead {0,12} with footer 8 is an alternate closure equivalent to native 12+footer9.
sensitivity_notes.identity_8: 8-byte controls scan ordinal|UID pairs without requiring a repeated UID lane; they are negative controls for the native 12-byte triple.
sensitivity_notes.uid_relaxation: allow_zero, no_uid_order, and both_relaxed are full DP controls; counts are not sampled.
